[EN] Hey, do you have a minute to talk about crystals?

My boss told me to come out here and sell until my inventory was gone, but monsters only seem to have gold after they're dead!

I don't suppose you're looking to buy, are you? I have all the popular varieties.
[ES] Oye, ¿tienes un minuto para hablar sobre crystals?

Mi jefe me dijo que viniera aquí a vender hasta que vaciara mi inventario, ¡pero los monstruos solo parecen tener oro después de muertos!

Supongo que no querrás comprar, ¿verdad? Tengo todas las variedades populares.
